_comment: Tape-measured ground truth for three rooms of a real 3BHK, captured 2026-10-04. Source values were written by hand in centimetres and are converted to metres here without rounding loss. This is the only independent reference the project has for a real building, and it is used for validation only, never to calibrate the pipeline: doing the latter would make every accuracy number circular.
_method: 5 m steel tape, read at eye level, pulled taut. Room length and width measured corner to corner at floor level between masking-tape corner marks. Height measured floor to ceiling. Diagonal measured corner to opposite corner. Door and window sizes are width x height of the opening.
known_gaps: Measurement cards were recorded on paper and photographed, but the card images are not in the captured media set. The numbers above were transcribed by hand, so a transcription error cannot be ruled out.
Only 3 rooms captured; a 3BHK implies at least one further bedroom and a kitchen. Bathrooms and balcony were deliberately skipped as low value per minute.
No 1 m scale marker appears in any frame, so the photo tier has no independent scale reference.
Damage recorded: one crack, two frames, in the second bedroom. Not the five overlapping close shots plus one wide context shot the protocol asks for.
The four session videos are not labelled by room.
